- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended museums in Paris for impressionist art:
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Musée d'Orsay - Known for its large collection of impressionist and post-impressionist art, located in a former train station.

  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Musée Marmottan Monet - Houses the largest collection of Monet's works, including Impression, Sunrise.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Petit Palais - Features a collection of French art from ancient times to the early 20th century, including works by Monet, Renoir, and Degas.
  - [ASSISTANT_SAID] Fondation Louis Vuitton - A contemporary art museum featuring modern artists as well as impressionist and post-impressionist paintings.
